headline: City Residents Attempt To Achieve 'Universal Acceptance' By Inviting Every Single Stranger They See To Sunday Lunch
body:
“I tried to be inclusive yesterday, but the local bus conductor was very confused when I offered him a plate of my grandmother’s biryani right at the traffic signal,” said local commuter Rahul Verma.

“My neighbors have started locking their doors since I insisted that our apartment corridor is now a communal dining zone where anyone is free to join for tea,” noted suburban resident Meera Iyer.

“I’ve been standing outside the vegetable market all morning with an extra spoon, but everyone keeps assuming I’m just trying to sell them a subscription to a meal kit service,” remarked student Ankit Sharma.

“The instruction seemed clear enough, so I’ve cleared out my living room sofa to make space for twelve random passersby, though my cat is currently the only one enjoying the hospitality,” added retired shopkeeper Suresh Kulkarni.
caption: From grand philosophy to lunch invitations, how far is too far? We asked the residents of the city about their new, sudden commitment to radical hospitality. #Unity #LunchGoals #CityLife (satire)
igHook: Would you open your house to a complete stranger for Sunday lunch?
